reason: I compare prices myself shop by shop in the market and my cousin's electrician already wired his system, so I'd just go to him. An app with companies I don't know doesn't beat walking the market and haggling face to face.
objection: These are strangers from an app. I can't haggle with a written offer, and I don't know who is behind SunXFinder or whether the companies are just padding prices because they know you're comparing.
would_change_my_mind: If my relative or a neighbour told me they got a cheaper price through it than in the market, I'd send our electrician's quote to get it checked for free.
